Q. 3 اِسْلَنْطَحَ It (a thing) was, or became, long and wide. (AA, O and L in this art.: mentioned in the S in art. سطح.) ―
-b2- It (a valley) became wide: (K:) accord. to IF, both the ل and ن are added to give intensiveness to the signification. (O.) ―
-b3- He (a man) extended himself or became extended [app. on the ground]; syn. اِنْبَسَطَ: (L:) or he became thrown down upon his face: or he lay, or lay as though thrown down or extended: or he stretched himself; or lay, and stretched himself; upon his face, extended upon the ground: syn. اِنْطَبَحَ: (O:) or he lay as though thrown down or extended, upon the back of his neck: (Ibn-'Abbád, O:) or he (a man, L) fell upon his face: (L, K:) and upon his back. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
